label: Diagram 16
caption: Diagram 16 An example of a shared refreshment facility | Sleeping accommodation
description: This is a plan of a shared refreshment facility: an L-shaped worktop with a sink and drainer at the top, a person in a wheelchair drawn at the sink, and a dashed outline of the clear space under the worktop, labelled "Clear space under worktop", with a vertical dimension of "800mm" on the left giving its depth. A "Microwave oven" sits on the left-hand run, with a dashed "Refrigerator under worktop" beside it, and a label reads "Work surface 850mm above floor level". "Floor unit" labels mark the units at the top right and the bottom, a door swings at the right, and a dashed square in the middle is labelled "1500mm x 1500mm Wheelchair turning space".
first_draft: This is a plan view illustrating a shared refreshment facility. The drawing shows a worktop with several appliances. At the top, a label "Clear space under worktop" points to the area above a dashed line, and a "Floor unit" is indicated on the right. On the left, a vertical dimension of "80mm" is shown. Below this, a "Microwave oven" is depicted as a rectangle within a counter section. The main worktop is shown in the centre, featuring a sink with a tap, a four-burner hob, and a refrigerator at the top. A label indicates the "Work surface 850mm above floor level", and another points to the "Refrigerator under worktop". On the right side, a swing-out shelf is drawn, projecting from the counter. At the bottom, a "Floor unit" is marked, and the bottom right corner is labelled as a "1500mm x 1500mm Wheelchair turning space".

check.note: Reads the 800mm dimension as "80mm", calls the plan a front elevation, and invents a hob; there is a sink, a microwave and a fridge under the worktop.
